list.title: Skills
list.description: Instructions and files in the Agent Skills format, loaded by agents when they need them.
list.empty: No skills yet. <discover>Find one on skills.sh</discover> or <create>write your own</create>.

form.name: Name
form.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
form.slugHint: The identifier agents use in skill_read.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: When the agent should use this skill, in one sentence.
form.assignmentDescription: Agents get the skill directly or through the projects they belong to.
form.deleteCardDescription: It is also removed from every assignment. This cannot be undone.
form.deleteDescription: Agents will no longer see it in the prompt. Export it first if you want a copy.
form.activeHint: When disabled, it no longer shows up for any agent.
form.filesDescription: SKILL.md holds the instructions. Agents open the other files when SKILL.md points to them.
form.testSummary: Try the skill with an agent in a real conversation.

test.title: Test
test.description: Run the skill with an agent and see what the agent receives.
test.hint: The agent gets this skill for the test, even if it is not assigned or the skill is off.
test.dirtyHint: Unsaved changes are not included: the test uses the last saved version.
test.saveFirst: Save the skill first to test it.
test.noAgents: No agents to test with yet.
test.promptPlaceholder: Ask for something this skill should handle, the way a user would.
test.cost: Runs the agent for real and uses tokens.
test.previewSummary: The line in the system prompt and what skill_read returns.
test.promptIntro:
You have access to these skills. When one fits, load it with skill_read before you start working.
skill_read returns SKILL.md and the list of the skill's other files; when the instructions point to one of them, read it with skill_read and its path.
test.otherFiles: The other files are read on demand with <mono>{call}</mono>.

import.title: Import a skill
import.description: From your computer or from a link. You see every file before it is added.
import.dropTitle: Drop a skill folder, a .zip or a SKILL.md here
import.dropHint: Text files only; binary files are left out.
import.noSkillMd: No SKILL.md found. A skill folder needs one at its top level.
import.unreadable: Could not read these files. If it is a zip, check that it is not damaged.
import.linkHint: A GitHub link to a repository, folder or SKILL.md, a skills.sh page, or owner/repo.
import.found: {count, plural, one {# skill found} other {# skills found}} in <mono>{source}</mono>. Pick one to preview.
import.noName: The SKILL.md has no name in its frontmatter.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every save with changes keeps a version you can compare and restore.
versions.single: Only v{version} so far: every save with changes adds a version here.
versions.lineStats: {added, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, one {# removed} other {# removed}}
versions.unchanged: {count, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}
versions.restoreDescription: The name, description and files become the ones from v{version}, saved as a new version. Assignments and the on/off state do not change.

editor.pathTaken: A file or folder already has this path
editor.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file added} other {# files added}}

editor.deleteDescription: The file is removed from the skill when you save.
editor.skillMdPlaceholder:
# Title

Steps, rules and examples for the agent...
editor.template:
## When to use

The situations where this skill applies.

## Steps

1. First step
2. Second step

## Rules

- What to always or never do

## Examples

A short example of good output.

For long reference material, add files such as references/guide.md and link to them from here.

preview.note: Its instructions go into the agent's prompt, so read them first: a skill written by someone else can carry instructions you would not want an agent to follow.
